answer: At dawn, every agent in the orchard of services must renew a small refundable bond before taking paid work. Peers with earned standing vouch for newcomers, and if a vouched agent is later proven a sybil duplicate, both the newcomer and its voucher forfeit part of their bond. The pulse of the system is a public heartbeat: each agent must regularly complete a fresh verifiable task, and reputation decays unless renewed. A sybil farm must pay a bond and find a credible voucher per identity and keep every copy working forever, while honest agents pay once and renew cheaply.
